_about: Atlas settings. Copy to atlas.config.json (the installer does it) and edit. Paths starting with ~ are inside C:\Users\<you>. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_wait_for: At sign-in, Atlas waits up to 90 seconds for this folder (a cloud drive) before its first scan. Remove if you have none.
_sources: Where your files live, most specific path first. rank: which copy counts as the original when the same file is in two places (lower wins). archive: an old backup; its folders become Superseded when most files are older copies or unchanged for years.
_index: The folders Atlas reads (names, sizes and dates only; no file is opened, so cloud files are not downloaded).
_read_write: Folders the file browser may change (rename, move, delete to the Recycle Bin). Their top folder itself is never changed.
_read_only: Folders the file browser may show but never change. Anything not listed in either is out of reach.
_fixed: Folders with a place of their own. kind 'tree' links a folder as it is, read only, with its first level shown on the map (for a shared or controlled folder you must never rearrange).
_parents: Where Atlas looks for folders to place: [source, folder, depth]. Depth 1 places each subfolder; depth 2 the folders one level further down.
_names: Folder names (lower case, | between them) that always go to a category.
_keywords: Words that vote for a category when they appear in a folder's name or its files' names. After a | come two-word phrases.

keywords.01: client clients invoice invoices proposal proposals contract contracts meeting meetings report reports
keywords.02: project projects prototype concept design draft drafts|side project
keywords.03: course courses lecture lectures notes homework exam exams thesis paper papers
keywords.04: house home rent lease mortgage utility utilities repair garden
keywords.05: photo photos travel trip family vacation receipt receipts tax taxes bank insurance car
keywords.06: ebook ebooks book books manual manuals datasheet datasheets reference references tutorial tutorials font fonts

_doc_numbers: Optional: if your files carry document numbers, a regular expression for them and the category they point to.

ui.tree_note: Linked as it is and never rearranged.
ui.tree_readonly_note: Read only here: this folder is never changed from Atlas.
